Synopsis:
    Goldman Sachs opens a dedicated AI and cloud engineering office in Bellevue, WA, housing 125+ employees. The move reflects GS's broader AI investment push, leveraging Pacific Northwest tech talent. With 12,000+ engineers (~25% of global headcount), GS is deepening its technical infrastructure to maintain competitive positioning in AI-driven finance.
